name: Ringbuffer
description: A high-performance, cross-platform circular buffer library with a three-stage pipelined architecture — byte-identical source across macOS and 5 Linux distros, plus an LLM knowledge package for fine-tuning.
features: Three-stage pipelined architecture (Read → Transform → Write) with lock-free threading
Cache-line-aligned counters to prevent false sharing
Integrated checksumming (MD5, SHA256, SHA512) per buffer slot
C++20 with std::jthread and cooperative cancellation
Multi-language: C++, Java, Python — all at v1.0.0
Byte-identical source across macOS, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu, and Raspberry Pi OS
Automated binary symmetry verification across all platforms
LLM Knowledge Package: versioned context docs, Ollama Modelfile, and QLoRA training data for fine-tuning
lesson: prompt-driven development, binary symmetry across operating systems, building a library-first API with lock-free concurrent data structures, and packaging knowledge for LLM fine-tuning
feedback_area: the pipelined architecture, the cross-platform binary symmetry approach, or the LLM knowledge package design
